skills.name: study-coach
skills.description: Use when the user wants to learn or deeply understand something via a guided coaching session: 'coach me on X', 'teach me X', 'help me study this article/URL/file', 'I want to learn X'. Accepts a topic, URL, or local path, saves a coaching note, then flows into recall unless --no-recall. For re-testing a topic already coached use study-recall; for config use study-setup.

skills.name: study-recall
skills.description: Use when the user wants to test or reinforce what they learned on a topic already coached or studied: 'quiz me on X', 'recall session for X', 'Feynman test on X', 'explain X back to you', 'review what I learned about X'. Targets gaps in the existing coaching note and logs the result. For first-time learning use study-coach.

skills.name: study-setup
skills.description: Use when configuring the study plugin or it reports missing config: 'set up study', 'configure study notes folder', 'change study notes path', 'add a content vault'. Writes study.md with notes_path and content_vaults. Run before first study-coach or study-recall use.

commands.name: coach
commands.description: Start a coaching session on any topic, URL, or local file

commands.name: recall
commands.description: Run a Feynman recall session on a previously coached topic

commands.name: study-setup
commands.description: Configure the study plugin - set notes folder and content vault paths

agents.description: Use this agent to run an adaptive coaching session on any topic or content. Supports multiple learning gears (Socratic, Explain, Guide, Check, Help) and saves a structured coaching note with identified gaps for use in future recall sessions.
Use this agent to extract content from URLs (research papers, YouTube videos, web articles) or local files (PDF, markdown, text) for use in a coaching session.
Use this agent to run a Feynman recall session. Reads an existing coaching note to target known gaps, runs iterative explanation cycles, and appends results to the Recall Log.
